testcase.name: Scenario: Repeat the active compact panel button: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:497:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Repeat the active compact panel button ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons ✔ When the user clicks the Options panel button ✔ Then the temporary Options command panel appears below the button strip ✔ And the Options panel button is highlighted ✔ When the user clicks the Options panel button again ✔ Then the temporary Options command panel remains visible ✔ And the Options panel button remains highlighted ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display-mode menu ✔ Then the menu shows "Minimize to Panel Buttons" as selected ✔ And the temporary Options command panel remains visible ✔ When the user selects "Minimize to Tabs" ✔ Then the temporary Options command panel closes ✔ And the ribbon displays tabs without a permanent panel-button strip
